name: Atlassian Rovo
description: Search, create, and update Jira issues, Confluence pages, and Jira Service Management tickets, and read, commit to, and open pull requests on Bitbucket repos - all through Atlassian's official hosted MCP server, powered by your Teamwork Graph.
notes: OAuth 2.1 is handled entirely by the Atlassian Rovo MCP server. No client credentials required - sign in with your Atlassian account when the authentication flow starts. This is Atlassian MCP v2, which lists its most-used tools directly and the rest through its discover and execute tools; it is also the MCP server for Bitbucket Cloud.
installHint: Atlassian Rovo is Atlassian's hosted MCP server for Atlassian Cloud: it reaches Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud, and Bitbucket Cloud workspaces linked to an Atlassian organization, but not Jira, Confluence, or Bitbucket Data Center.
